worldcombat.skill.venoshock.summary: Hurl a glob of corrosive venom on a low arc. Against a poisoned or badly poisoned target the damage is doubled and that poison is escalated to badly poisoned with a longer clock; a miss just leaves a splash of venom.
The venom deals %1$s special damage; it is doubled against a poisoned target.
Against a poisoned target the poison is escalated to badly poisoned, lasting %1$s.
The venom flies at %1$s blocks per tick with %2$s gravity, shoving the target %3$s blocks along the spray.
worldcombat.skill.venoshock.preference.c: On: immediate power ×0.85 but the escalated poison lasts ×1.6, with 2/4 ticks more recover and cooldown. Off: a heavier glob with the baseline toxin clock.
worldcombat.skill.venoshock.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of firing. Larger values open up from further away.
When on, the user may leave its post to find a firing line; when off, it only fires on what it can reach from where it stands.
